name: Mometasone Nasal Spray
mechanism: Potent topical corticosteroid for nasal inflammation
dosing: Adults: 2 sprays each nostril OD (100mcg/spray). Children ≥3y: 1 spray each nostril OD
contraindications: Untreated nasal infection, recent nasal surgery
monitoring: Symptom control, epistaxis, growth in children
pregnancy: Use if benefit outweighs risk - minimal absorption
clinicalPearls: Often preferred over fluticasone for once-daily dosing. Licensed from age 3
